name: Fair Princess Under Futa Curse
source:
A beautiful fair princess was cursed by an evil witch to become a futanari. The evil witch caused the princess' vagina to grow into a huge penis she could not control. As time passed, the penis grew bigger as well as the princess' lust for sex. Play as the princess and explore her journey of sexual transformation from a girl to futanari, and how she finds love through it all! Explore her sexual transformation in this non-linear life simulation visual novel where you get to choose which actions the princess takes.

The story starts out in the typical way, but quickly becomes much more strange. At first you will be enjoying your daily life as a princess. However, a terrible curse has been cast upon you, and turned you into a futanari, growing a gigantic penis. This penis is no ordinary penis, it demands constant pleasure - no matter where or when. But being a princess you are forced to hide your newfound desires.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2191090/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一位美丽的公主被邪恶女巫诅咒，变成了扶她。女巫的诅咒让公主长出了她无法控制的巨大阴茎。随着时间推移，阴茎越来越大，公主对性爱的欲望也日渐强烈。扮演公主，探索她从女孩变为扶她的性转历程，以及她如何在这一切之中找到爱情！这是一款非线性的人生模拟视觉小说，你可以选择公主采取何种行动，体验她的性转过程。

故事起初看似寻常，却很快变得愈发离奇。最初，你会享受身为公主的日常生活；然而，可怕的诅咒降临于你，将你变成扶她，并使你长出巨大的阴茎。这并非普通的阴茎，它需要不断得到快感满足，无论何时何地。可你身为公主，只能隐藏新萌生的欲望。
